why: HLSL was shipped but not a required root conformance lane: no lane compiled the shaders the runtime loads from disk, and no lane executed one and compared its output with a reference. This contract declares which shader roots are required, which files are excluded and why, and the laws the lane enforces.

roots.why: loaded from disk by the runtime (svg_compute.hlsl, geodesic_propagator.hlsl) or embedded verbatim (attention.hlsl); a file here that does not compile is a runtime defect, not a documentation issue
fold-space gate/GEMM/score kernels shipped for the fold binding registry's hlsl backend

the D3D12 XVM lane is not built or dispatched by this runtime, so its files are compiled and accounted for by name but do not gate the root claim; an excluded file that starts compiling fails the lane until the exclusion is removed

excluded.reason: X4026: GroupMemoryBarrierWithGroupSync sits inside divergent flow guarded by q_idx; the D3D12 XVM lane is unbuilt, so this is a recorded defect instead of a silent pass
X4026: the same divergent-barrier defect on the fused QKV path

laws.H1: every entry point discovered in a shader of a required root compiles under the declared target profile
laws.H2: every .hlsl file under a declared root is either compiled or excluded by name; an unaccounted file fails the lane
laws.H3: an excluded file that compiles is a stale exclusion and fails the lane until it is promoted back into the required set
laws.H4: a compile failure names the shader, entry point and target, and is never reported as a shape pass
laws.H5: the execution case compiles a shipped shader from disk, dispatches it on the available device and matches an independently computed CPU reference; with no device the lane reports UNAVAILABLE rather than PASS
laws.H6: the lane compiles with the in-process compiler (d3dcompiler) and cross-checks with fxc when it is installed; a disagreement fails the lane

execution.domain: result[i] = arc_weight * (node_a[i] + node_b[i]) over 16 elements, dispatch(1,1,1) with [numthreads(64,1,1)]
